name: Paranacaiman
sum: Large caiman from the Late Miocene Ituzaingó Formation of Argentina, named in 2024 from a skull table.
wsnote: Described as large; the sources give no measurements.
holotype: MACN-Pv 13551 — an isolated skull table, Ituzaingó Formation, Argentina (once part of "Caiman lutescens").
biology: One of several large caimans in the Late Miocene of Paraná.
author: Bona et al. 2024

sources.text: Bona, P.; Barrios, F.; Ezcurra, M.D.; Victoria, M.; Blanco, F.; Cidade, G.M. 2024. New taxa of giant caimans from the southernmost hyperdiverse wetlands of the South American late Miocene. Journal of Systematic Palaeontology 22(1). doi:10.1080/14772019.2024.2375027
